snippet.title: Cards and Castles Ultimate - Raw Gameplay Preview (Tactical Strategy Card Game)
snippet.description:
Cards and Castles ULTIMATE is the third game in the Cards and Castles series, following up on the original Cards and Castles mobile game from 2013. This new, greatly improved version will be available on Steam, iOS and Android early next year. This is a short unfiltered video of a campaign mission being played in real time. WISHLIST NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3684810/Cards_and_Castles_Ultimate/
